## Summary
This video covers a major week in AI releases, highlighting new tools for 4x video upscaling, consistent manga colorization, and ultra-fast text-to-speech models. It also details massive updates like MiniMax-1's 4-million-token context window, ChatGPT's new 'Tasks' scheduling feature, and high-performance video generators like Luma Ray 2 and Vidu 2.0.

## Key Points
- Star is a new open-source AI capable of 4x video upscaling with high temporal consistency.
- Manga Ninja allows for consistent colorization of comic art using reference images and point-driven control.
- Kokuro TTS is a highly efficient 82M parameter model ranked #1 on text-to-speech leaderboards.
- SVFR (Stable Video Face Restoration) provides a unified system for face sharpening, colorization, and inpainting.
- ChatGPT 'Tasks' allows users to schedule recurring prompts or one-time reminders within the interface.
- MiniMax-1 released a model with an industry-leading 4-million-token context window.
- Nvidia's Sauna image generator now supports 4K resolution at high speeds under an Apache 2.0 license.
- Luma Labs launched Ray 2, a significant upgrade in cinematic quality and motion consistency for AI video.
- Unitree demonstrated a humanoid robot capable of natural running and jogging on uneven terrain.

## AI Concepts
Video Super Resolution, Text-to-Speech (TTS), Mixture of Experts (MoE), Context Window, Inpainting, Point-driven control, Latent Regularization, Temporal Consistency, Spatial-temporal augmentation
